role_map.d1: inside (hole) diameter, nominal = lower limit (clearance wider than ISO 7092/7089)

notes: ISO 7094 round-hole washer, grade C, 100 HV (steel). The rows kept are the DIN 440 R-compatible sizes M5-M27; ISO 7094 additionally lists M30 (d1 33, d2 105, h 6), M33 (36/115/8) and M36 (39/125/8) but only two independent sources were found (fasteners.eu, globalfastener), so they were dropped. At M33 DIN 440 R differs from ISO 7094. The square-hole variants (ISO 7094 V / DIN 440 V) are not part of this table.

verification.checks_done: Live re-fetch of fasteners.eu, globalfastener (with Referer), schrauben-lexikon, torqbolt, boltport. Matrix 15 sizes (M5..M36 incl. non-preferred) x (d1,d2,h) x 6 tables. All 10 kept rows (M5,M6,M8,M10,M12,M16,M20,M22,M24,M27) x 3 cols = 30 cells identical in fe, gf and sl (3 clusters each), and in boltport and torqbolt table 1 (not counted). Only dissent: torqbolt table 2 M12 d1 14.0 / M16 d1 18.0 (rounded). Dropped rows M14, M18, M30, M33, M36 confirmed to exist only in fe + gf (sl/boltport list 10 DIN 440 sizes). Headers: fe 'd1 nominal min. / d2 nominal max. / h nominal', gf 'd min=nominal size / dc max=nominal size / h Nominal Size', sl 'd mm / d2 mm / h'. Physical sanity: d1,d2,h monotone, d2/d1 3.1-3.3, d1 > thread dia.
problems: Every kept cell has exactly 3 clusters (fe, gf, sl) under the STRICT reading.
M22 and M27 are 'non-preferred dimensions' of ISO 7094 (fasteners.eu lists them under a separate 'Non-preferred' heading); values still identical in all three clusters.
globalfastener carries no thread label (only d1 values); the M label for each gf column is matched through the unique d1 value (verified against fe/sl for all 15 columns).
gf footnotes (circled 1/2) on d1 max 20.84 and h min 5 are on limit columns that the record does not publish.
ISO 7094 vs DIN 440 R: record claims '= DIN 440 R for these sizes'; DIN page not re-checked here (producer found M33 differs, irrelevant to kept rows). Square-hole V variant excluded.

standard_full: ISO 7094:2000 (plain washers, extra large series, product grade C, 100 HV; = DIN 440 R round hole for these sizes)
